verdict.rationale: Twilio Segment is a SaaS customer data platform rather than an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The Public API, Profile API and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks an agent could be wired to, and the docs' 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor' buttons are a separate documentation feature. Neither counts as an official MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
